page.title_en: ADC12DJ5200SE 12-bit 10.4GSPS RF Sampling ADC with JESD204C
page.meta_description_en: 12-bit, 10.4GSPS RF-sampling ADC with integrated baluns. Supports dual-channel 5.2GSPS. Features JESD204C interface, DDC, and noiseless aperture delay. Ideal for 5G, SATCOM, and SDR.
page.meta_description_zh: 12位10.4GSPS射频采样ADC，集成巴伦。支持双通道5.2GSPS，具备JESD204C接口、DDC和无噪声采样延迟，适用于5G、卫星通信及软件定义无线电。
